title: Hey Google phone kaise sunta hai?
hooks: Screen off hai, phone lock hai. Par Hey Google bolte hi ye turant jaag jata hai.
Kya aapka smartphone aapki har secret baat 24 ghante sun raha hai?
Phone locked table par pada hai, fir bhi use aapki aawaz kaise sunayi di?
hook_why: Immediate relatable observation of a locked, dark phone instantly reacting to speech creates instant curiosity without feeling like a conspiracy video.
metaphor: A sleepy giant guarded by a tiny gatekeeper chip who only recognizes one specific secret handshake.

scenes.vo: Screen off hai, phone lock hai. Par Hey Google bolte hi ye turant jaag jata hai.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic studio shot of a sleek matte black smartphone resting flat on an obsidian black surface, screen pitch black then suddenly emitting a soft luminous pulse from the center, photorealistic premium studio product render on pure black.
scenes.label: STANDBY MODE

scenes.vo: Toh kya phone aapki har baat 24 ghante chupke se sun raha hai?
Bilkul nahi. Agar har baat internet par jaati, toh battery do ghante mein khatam ho jaati.
scenes.label: BATTERY DRAIN

scenes.vo: Asal mein phone ka main processor gehre sleep mode mein soya hota hai.
scenes.prompt: Close up macro view of a large dark silicon mobile system on chip processor on a motherboard, faint cooling traces, completely dormant with subtle dim ambient blue edge light, photorealistic premium studio product render on pure black.
scenes.label: MAIN CPU SLEEP

scenes.vo: Pehre par baitha hota hai ek micro chip. Naam hai... DSP.
scenes.label: POWER USAGE

scenes.vo: Ye chip aawaz ko lagataar chhotey digital pattern mein check karta hai.
scenes.title: ACOUSTIC ANALYZER
scenes.label: SIGNAL CHECK

scenes.vo: Sirf ek second ka audio banta hai, aur turant delete hota rehta hai.
scenes.label: ROLLING BUFFER

scenes.vo: Lekin jaise hi Hey Google ka sound pattern match hota hai...
scenes.prompt: Macro technical shot of an audio coprocessor chip firing a brilliant sharp yellow golden trace pulse along a printed circuit board trace, photorealistic premium studio product render on pure black.
scenes.label: HARDWARE INTERRUPT

scenes.vo: Ye chip soye hue main processor ko jagata hai, aur screen on ho jaati hai.
scenes.label: Wake Flow
scenes.title: Chip Wake Up

scenes.vo: Matlab wake word phone ke andar pakda gaya, kisi server par nahi.
scenes.label: PROCESSING SPLIT

scenes.vo: Aap voice assistant on rakhte ho ya off? Comment mein batao.

caption:
Phone band hone par bhi 'Hey Google' kaise sun leta hai? 📱 Aur kya ye hamari sabhi baatein record karta hai? Sach jaano hardware level par. Aap voice assistant use karte ho ya off rakhte ho?

Music: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

claims.claim: Continuous cloud audio streaming 24/7 would exhaust smartphone battery within hours.
claims.basis: Mobile cellular transceivers and main application processors consume hundreds of milliwatts to several watts during continuous transmission compared to standby idle states.

claims.claim: Modern smartphones use a low power dedicated DSP or audio coprocessor that stays awake while the main processor sleeps.
claims.basis: Android Voice Interaction architecture and hardware implementations like Qualcomm Hexagon DSP or Apple Always On Processor dedicate micro-watt coprocessors to hotword detection.

claims.claim: Audio is kept in a rolling circular buffer of approximately one to a few seconds and continuously discarded unless the wake word acoustic pattern matches.
claims.basis: Official Android Hotword Detection Service specification confirms raw audio is kept in an ephemeral local ring buffer and purged unless a verified hardware interrupt occurs.
